Subject: 238th Board Meeting of Acme Textiles Limited

Dear Sir,

Notice is hereby given that the 238th Board Meeting of 'Acme Textiles Limited' is scheduled to take
place at its Karachi Office, Plot 9, Sector 23, Korangi Industrial Area, Karachi, Pakistan
in person or through video-link on October 23, 2026 at 05:00 p.m. to consider the accounts for the
quarter ended 30 September 2026 and for declaration of any entitlement.

In addition to the above, the Company has declared the closed period from October 16, 2026 to
October 23, 2026 (both days inclusive) in accordance with Rule 5.6.1(d) of the Rule Book of the
Pakistan Stock Exchange.

In view of the foregoing, no Director, Chief Executive Officer or Executive shall, directly or
indirectly, deal in the shares of the Company in any manner during the Closed Period.

You may please inform the TRE Certificate Holders of the Exchange accordingly

Kind Regards,

Nadia Farooq
Company Secretary
